scenarios.title: Scavenge exiles the card and puts counters equal to its power on the target creature
decisions: A activates scavenge of Dreg Mangler from the graveyard, paying {3}{B}{G} (tapping all five lands) and exiling Dreg Mangler as a cost, targeting Grizzly Bears.
B passes or responds as the variant states; then the ability resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Dreg Mangler is in exile. The ability resolves and puts three +1/+1 counters (Dreg Mangler's power) on Grizzly Bears, which is 5/5.

variants.label: target_killed_in_response
variants.delta: In response, B casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
variants.expected: Shock resolves first and Grizzly Bears is destroyed. Dreg Mangler stays exiled because the cost was already paid. The scavenge ability has no legal target and fizzles; no counters are placed.

scenarios.forge_notes: Dreg Mangler's power for the counter count must come from last known information after it is exiled as a cost.

scenarios.title: Scavenge can be activated only from the graveyard and only at sorcery timing

setup.notes: The stack is empty and A has priority.

decisions: A tries to activate scavenge of Dreg Mangler targeting Grizzly Bears, paying {3}{B}{G} with the five lands.

variants.label: graveyard_main_phase
variants.expected: The activation is legal: Dreg Mangler is in the graveyard, it is A's main phase and the stack is empty.

variants.label: combat_step
variants.delta: It is A's declare_attackers step instead of main1.
variants.expected: The activation is illegal: scavenge can be activated only as a sorcery, and it is not a main phase.

variants.label: card_in_hand
variants.delta: Dreg Mangler is in A's hand instead of the graveyard.
variants.expected: The activation is illegal: scavenge works only while the card is in a graveyard. A can only cast Dreg Mangler.
